email_subject: Application - Digital Marketing Specialist at Televic Conference
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist role at Televic Conference. Your focus on turning digital marketing into qualified demand and measurable pipeline growth resonates with how I work: connecting SEO, content, and web into a system that generates leads, not just traffic.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I build and optimize WordPress sites, run technical SEO and GEO audits, and write content that ranks. I use Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and iterate. I also hold a HubSpot Content Marketing certification and have hands-on experience with marketing automation concepts. My technical background (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python) lets me implement tracking and improvements directly.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help Televic Conference grow its digital engine. Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist position at Televic Conference. Your emphasis on turning digital activity into qualified demand, strong leads, and measurable business growth aligns perfectly with my approach to digital marketing. I thrive on connecting channels—website, search, content, and automation—to create journeys that attract the right audiences and drive pipeline.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO and AI search specialist and as a junior digital marketer at Episto, I've built and optimized WordPress websites, conducted technical SEO and GEO audits, and developed keyword-targeted content that improves organic visibility. I regularly use Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to measure performance and refine strategies. My HubSpot Content Marketing certification and hands-on experience with marketing automation concepts position me to contribute to your marketing automations in HubSpot. Additionally, my technical skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python enable me to implement tracking, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate effectively with developers.

What draws me to Televic Conference is the opportunity to shape a digital engine that directly supports business priorities. I enjoy translating goals into campaigns and customer journeys, and I'm eager to bring my mix of SEO, content, and technical skills to your team. I'm confident that my experience with website optimization, search visibility, and performance insights can help Televic Conference generate sales-ready leads and contribute to pipeline growth.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your digital marketing efforts. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• SEO & GEO expertise: on-page SEO, technical audits, structured data, and AI search visibility (llms.txt) to improve organic growth.
• Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads for data-driven decisions.
• CMS & content: WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), Shopify, and SEO content writing for lead generation.
• AI & automation: daily use of LLMs, prompt engineering, MCP integrations, and Python automation to streamline workflows.
• HubSpot Content Marketing certification and hands-on experience with marketing automation concepts.
